data.description:
## What
Update plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md Phase F to insert a cleanup recipe detection and execution step after sub-agents return and before Step 13 (code review).

## Why
Instruction-file update: sprint orchestrator needs explicit guidance to run applicable cleanup recipes after implementation sub-agents return, so reviewers see clean code rather than fixable mechanical defects.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Phase F gains a 'Cleanup Recipe Phase' step inserted between the Worktree Isolation Mode section and Step 7 (Acceptance Criteria Validation) — specifically after sub-agent results are collected and before Step 13 review
- SKILL.md cleanup step instructs: call bash $PLUGIN_SCRIPTS/sprint/detect-cleanup-recipes.sh; if output is non-empty, for each applicable recipe call bash $PLUGIN_SCRIPTS/../scripts/recipe-executor.sh <recipe_name> --param language=<lang>; log cleanup results to sprint log as post-cleanup state
- Conflict detection: if cleanup recipe reverts staged changes from the sub-agent implementation (detected via git diff --staged comparison before/after cleanup), log a WARNING and skip that recipe for those files
- No-op handling: if detect-cleanup-recipes.sh produces no output, skip the cleanup phase (no log entry)
- Sprint log records post-cleanup state (not pre-cleanup state) so completion-verifier sees accurate diffs
- Existing tests remain still-valid (SKILL.md is instruction-only)

## File Impact
- MODIFY: plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md

## Testing Mode
UPDATE — instruction-file change; tests still-valid

## Dependencies
- 17e0-e51e (detect-cleanup-recipes.sh must exist before SKILL.md references it)
data.title: UPDATE: Insert cleanup recipe phase in sprint Phase F (before Step 13 review)
